item.tib: zhang zhung me ri gyad phur gyi skong ba
item.coloph: me ri gyad phur gyi lha tshogs rnams bskang ba/ dbyings kyi bshags pa dang bcas pa/ dud men mtshon la tso dmar 'khrus nas/ 'od kyi rgyal po cham la phab dus/ zhang zhung snang bzher lod pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/ spa gro stag tshang nas khu tshas bton pa'o/ de nas rim par brgyud nas gshen nyi ma rgyal mtshan la bab pa'o//
